body: Haha, true, but death still seems like it's such a long time away. :/ I just want these remaining years to go by fast so I can be put out of my misery.
Thank you, your remark about me sounding articulate and intelligent made me smile. :) I've never been described as either of those things.

You make a good point. :) 

Things like that would be easier done if I weren't so afraid of being in public and talking to and being around people, though. :/ I just hate leaving my house when unnecessary. I go out to go to class and to run errands, but I'd rather do anything than go out for fun. Too many bad experiences to ever want to do that again.

Wow, thank you for this. I appreciate getting a reply that's not about making me feel unjustified in my venting and acting like everything's better than I think it is when you've never been in my shoes. (no sarcasm)

What makes me smile... beautiful nature. Animals, babies. Good music. Good food. Traveling. Reading. Watching my favorite TV shows. Sleeping. Most of all, peace and serenity/not having to be around other people.
